7274341.baseName: Argos Home Burgundy Bows Decoration -Pack of 6
7274341.variantName: Argos Home Burgundy Bows Decoration -Pack of 6
7274341.sourceDescription: These deep burgundy velvet bows bring a rich touch to your Halloween setup. You're getting 6 bows in the pack, so there's plenty to work with whether you're dressing up a table, adding texture to a wreath or giving pumpkins a bit of personality. The velvet finish gives them a luxe feel that lifts the usual spooky decor into something a bit more stylish. Tie them around napkins for place settings, clip them onto garlands or dot them across your mantlepiece. The burgundy tone works beautifully with autumn colours and adds depth without being too full-on festive. They're designed for indoor use, so you can layer them into your Halloween styling however you like. . 6 decorations included.; Contains 6 - Burgundy velvet bows.; Size H29.7, W1, D12cm.; Made from velvet.; Suitable for indoor usage.

6p1c4wzq.baseName: Walplus Artificial Christmas Tree - Black - 180 cm
6p1c4wzq.variantName: Walplus Artificial Christmas Tree - Black - 180 cm
6p1c4wzq.sourceDescription: This metal Christmas tree is ideal for anyone who loves DIY decoration and is looking for Christmas trees with a modern look. DIY decoration: You have the freedom to unleash your creativity on the metal Xmas tree, where you can combine it with lightweight LED lights, fairy lights, pine branches, or other Christmas decorations to craft a one-of-a-kind, attention-grabbing decoration for your home.Sturdy construction: The Christmas decoration stand has a steel frame and is supported by a wooden base for stability and sturdiness. Each branch has 2 silicone sleeves that are provided for fixation, preventing the branches from moving around freely.Space-saving design: After use, you can disassemble the metal Christmas tree stand into multiple parts, and conveniently store all of them in a space-saving manner. Good to know:The delivery includes a tree frame only; decorations are not included. Product Specifications Colour: Black Powder-coated steel, solid pine wood Overall dimensions: 90 x 90 x 180 cm (L x W x H) Total height: 180 cm Stand size: 60 x 60 cm (L x W) Number of rods: 19 Feature with a hexagonal tube Suitable for sheltered areas such as roofs, balconies, canopies, etc. Assembly required: Yes • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
